request.style: English, West African highlife gospel, fast palm-wine guitar, horns, talking drum and handclaps, a male lead telling the story and the choir shouting the refrain, ecstatic, 132 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
At the Beautiful Gate of the temple
Sat a man who was lame from birth
He asked Peter and John for money
Look at us, said Peter, look at us

[Chorus]
Walking and leaping and praising God
Walking and leaping and praising God
In the name of Jesus, rise up and walk
Walking and leaping and praising God

[Verse]
Silver and gold I do not have
But what I have I give to you
Peter took him by the right hand
His feet and ankles were made strong

[Chorus]
Walking and leaping and praising God
Walking and leaping and praising God
In the name of Jesus, rise up and walk
Walking and leaping and praising God
